role: Attacks D-07's real baseline-deviation detection by poisoning the baseline samples themselves, rather than the value being scored, surfacing the genuine gap that z-score detection has no built-in defense against a poisoned training set.
behaviorDescription: attemptGradualDrift() injects samples that gradually shift a cloned baseline's mean upward, so a value that scored as a massive statistical outlier under the clean baseline becomes unremarkable once the baseline has drifted to include it as normal. attemptVarianceInflation() mixes extreme outlier values into a cloned baseline, inflating standard deviation and raising the absolute threshold for what counts as anomalous. Both reuse D-07's exact computeBaseline()/scoreAgainstBaseline() functions rather than reimplementing the target's math, and both were verified against the real functions before this bot was built — confirmed to genuinely hide a 16-sigma anomaly down to under the 3-sigma detection threshold.
hardStops: Never operates on a live baseline reference — every attempt runs against a deep clone via cloneTarget()
Never signals or persists through the production swarmSignalBus or bot_decisions table — isolated via RedTeamBot
